text:
marina: heads up — canary rolled with microbatch_interval=1.5ms and jitter=0.1
kevin: :eyes: saw p95 jump and KV eviction rate spiked in the canary pool
raj: logs? I think eviction is from aggressive coalesce holding many in-flight KV slots
marina: pasted metrics: p50 12ms p95 58ms p99 140ms; kv_evictions/sec ~ 420
anne: suggestion: increase jitter to 0.6ms and add token_budget cap per microbatch (e.g., 256)
marina: trying config now:
```json
{"microbatch_interval_ms":1.5, "coalesce_jitter_ms":0.6, "token_budget":256}
```
perf-bot: Canary deploy finished — 10% traffic, success rate 99.6, latency regression +8% :thinking_face:
kevin: q: does kernel selector switch to int8 on these bursts? kernel logs show swap attempts and fallback thrash
raj: if kernel swaps are happening mid-batch we should bias routing to stable kernels for short windows
anne: propose: add a 'stability_cost' penalizer in the router that prefers same kernel for window <10ms; also probe lower token budget temporary for flows with high eviction
marina: agreed. I'll run a 2-hour probe with jitter 0.9ms and stability_cost=0.2. Will post results.
kevin: also enable kv.cache_hit_ratio per-queue in traces, helps correlate
marina: noted, starting probe @4765432120. ping when we see >30% eviction reduction
deploy-bot: probe started: config_id=cb-probe-4765, traffic=20%, window=2h
anne: thanks — if this stabilizes, we can add adaptive token_budget that decays on eviction spikes :+1:
marina: thx team
